title: The Kardashians Use Artificial Intelligence to Make a Weird Sketch
key_facts: The premiere of season eight of The Kardashians opens with AI-made versions of the family in far-off places.
Kourtney Kardashian and Travis Barker drink tea in Japan; Khloe Kardashian is on safari in Kenya.
The AI versions glitch: Khloe's eye bulges, Kylie Jenner grows a tail, Kourtney's face becomes a fingernail.
The real family then steps in; Kim Kardashian asks "Have we been AI this whole time?" in the sketch.
The real Kris Jenner says the real family cannot be replaced.
Vulture's writer says the AI clip looks like a weird short video from TikTok.
quote_evidence: The episode opens with very obviously A.I. versions of the family in far-off places: Kourtney Kardashian and Travis Barker are drinking tea in Japan and Khloé Kardashian is on a safari in Kenya.
She claps back, “I don’t know who you think you’re talking to but this real family — real family — cannot be replaced.”
why_it_matters_hint: Famous people are using obviously AI-made video as a joke on mainstream TV.
event_date: Season eight premiere; exact air date not stated (Vulture published 9 Oct 2026 00:26 UTC).
notes: Short Vulture description of a TV segment; the article names the speaker as the 'real momager', read here as Kris Jenner.
